inventory.scope: AppShell registered route frame primary content wrapper
inventory.reason: All route archetypes now use APP_SHELL_COMPACT_PAGE_EDGE_CLASS with fixed compact viewport edges.

inventory.scope: surface-page, admin-console-container, premium-lesson-main shared page edge tokens
inventory.reason: Shared containers now read --platform-page-edge-x instead of mx-auto max-width caps.

inventory.scope: Interactive lesson runtime course-local header and main wrappers
inventory.reason: Repeated premium-lesson-main and course header page-level caps were removed from modern interactive courses.
inventory.removalCondition: Permanent runtime shell contract; new lessons must use shared compact page edges.

inventory.scope: Migrated representative teacher operations, resource, class, report, and control workbench shells touched by this change
inventory.reason: Only the listed shells were migrated in this change; remaining teacher pages with centered wrappers are tracked as temporary exceptions or future work.

inventory.scope: Representative learner portfolio workspace page shell touched by this change
inventory.reason: The listed non-teacher route shells no longer center the whole page in a wide-screen cap; root page remains outside this migration.
Print/PDF pages require a measured page width rather than workspace utilization.
Citation reading pages require a measured prose width for source inspection rather than workspace utilization.

inventory.scope: Dedicated textbook reader hierarchy, prose, and adjacent-unit measures
inventory.reason: The standalone and modal reader use bounded navigation columns and an 860px prose measure for sustained textbook reading; these widths belong to the reader component rather than the platform page frame.
inventory.removalCondition: Remove if the textbook reader adopts a shared reader-layout component that owns the same intrinsic hierarchy and prose measures.

inventory.scope: Legacy interactive resource detail route frame
inventory.reason: The legacy resource player still owns a centered 1440px route wrapper while adaptive journey completion is integrated into that existing surface.
inventory.removalCondition: Remove when the legacy resource detail route migrates to the shared AppShell compact page-edge frame.

inventory.reason: The centered max-w-sm class constrains an empty-state background illustration inside the Arena shell, not the page route frame.
inventory.removalCondition: Permanent media-illustration measure unless the empty-state asset component is replaced.

inventory.scope: Control Odyssey Arena context header content measure
inventory.reason: The max-w-7xl wrapper aligns the Arena bridge header content within the immersive Odyssey runtime and does not own the application page frame.
inventory.removalCondition: Remove if the Odyssey runtime adopts AppShell as its route frame.

inventory.reason: The centered max-width constrains QR image size, not the page shell.

inventory.scope: Annotated media image display measure inside the shared courseware panel
inventory.reason: The compact and medium maximum widths preserve a readable media display size inside the component.
inventory.removalCondition: Permanent media display measure unless the annotated media component is replaced.

inventory.scope: Legacy resource widgets and lesson-engine local components
inventory.reason: Legacy resource widgets still own their own component measures and are outside the modern AppShell/runtime shell migration surface.
inventory.removalCondition: Remove as each legacy resource is migrated into the shared compact workspace shell.

inventory.scope: Internal visual review and classroom retrospective pages
inventory.reason: Review pages use fixed comparison measures until internal review surfaces are moved into AppShell report-ledger shells.
inventory.removalCondition: Remove after review surfaces adopt the compact report-ledger frame.

inventory.path: src/app/(auth)/**, src/app/(main)/missions/page.tsx, src/app/teacher/classes/new/page.tsx, src/app/teacher/preset-lessons/page.tsx, src/app/teacher/history/page.tsx, src/app/teacher/arena/publications/[publicationId]/page.tsx, src/app/(main)/teacher/students/[studentId]/evidence/page.tsx, src/app/page.tsx
inventory.scope: Narrow auth, mission assistant, single-form/detail, root marketing, and legacy teacher/report flows not fully migrated by this change
inventory.reason: These flows require follow-up page-shell migration so route frames, not broad page wrappers, own page width.
inventory.removalCondition: Remove after auth and single-form routes move narrow measures into internal form components.

inventory.scope: Diagnosis delivery loading and error feedback measures
inventory.reason: The centered max-width wrapper bounds only the loading or failure message; the report itself is rendered by the shared delivery surface and verified separately at 1440px and 320px.
inventory.removalCondition: Permanent feedback-measure exception unless loading and failure feedback move into a shared status component.

inventory.scope: Diagnosis report reading measure and history empty/error feedback
inventory.reason: These bounds are intrinsic to a readable report ledger and its local status feedback, not to the AppShell route frame; dedicated diagnosis capture verifies the resulting desktop and narrow layouts.
inventory.removalCondition: Remove if the diagnosis report and its local feedback adopt a shared report-ledger reading-measure component.
